Application Data.NAME: Smith & Associates Realty
Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Smith & Associates Realty is a full-service real estate agency specializing in residential property transactions. We assist clients in buying, selling, and leasing properties while adhering to all applicable real estate laws and fair housing regulations. Our dedicated team conducts thorough market analyses to provide clients with accurate information and guidance throughout the transaction process. We maintain strong relationships with local lenders and inspectors to facilitate seamless transactions, while ensuring compliance with industry standards and regulations. Our operations are conducted from our office located at 123 Main Street, Suite 200, Springfield, IL, where we primarily engage in activities related to client consultations, property showings, and the preparation of necessary documentation for real estate transactions. We do not engage in property management or development services, focusing solely on the brokerage of residential properties.
